animals_source_check.name: animals_source_check
animals_source_check.value: "animals"."source" in ('first', 'level', 'buy') and ("animals"."source" = 'level') = ("animals"."source_level" is not null) and ("animals"."source_level" is null or ("animals"."source_level" > 0 and "animals"."source_level" % 5 = 0))

animals_egg_check.name: animals_egg_check
animals_egg_check.value: ("animals"."species" is null) = ("animals"."hatched_at" is null) and ("animals"."species" is not null or ("animals"."growth" = 0 and "animals"."grown_at" is null))

comments_content_check.name: comments_content_check
comments_content_check.value: ("comments"."deleted_at" is null and char_length("comments"."content") between 1 and 1000) or ("comments"."deleted_at" is not null and "comments"."content" = '')

follows_town_lot_check.name: follows_town_lot_check
follows_town_lot_check.value: "follows"."town_lot" is null or ("follows"."town_lot" between 1 and 10 and "follows"."is_favorite")

items_growth_check.name: items_growth_check
items_growth_check.value: ("items"."type" = 'growth') = ("items"."growth_value" is not null) and ("items"."growth_value" is null or "items"."growth_value" > 0)

notifications_shape_check.name: notifications_shape_check
notifications_shape_check.value: ("notifications"."kind" = 'level_up' and "notifications"."actor_id" is null and "notifications"."post_id" is null and "notifications"."level" between 2 and 99) or ("notifications"."kind" <> 'level_up' and "notifications"."actor_id" is not null and "notifications"."post_id" is not null and "notifications"."level" is null)

posts_subcategory_needs_category.name: posts_subcategory_needs_category
posts_subcategory_needs_category.value: "posts"."subcategory_id" is null or "posts"."category_id" is not null

replies_content_check.name: replies_content_check
replies_content_check.value: ("replies"."deleted_at" is null and char_length("replies"."content") between 1 and 1000) or ("replies"."deleted_at" is not null and "replies"."content" = '')
